LESSON: VISUAL PROGRAMMING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.4: Visual Programming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Visual Programming. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are computer programs used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application
   In simple words: practise until you can create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Visual Programming using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Visual Programming in the examples.
2. Explain Visual Programming to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Visual Programming.
4. Show that you can: identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual Programming using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Visual Programming important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Launch and discuss the different features of visual programming applications (input, processing, output, effects such as sound, animations and background),
2. Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and team working skills when discussing the features of a visual programming application.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
